files.Makefile:
load ./pressure.so
VALUE := outer
$(file >>seen,read-before)
START = $(guile (begin (use-modules (ice-9 threads)) (call-with-new-thread (lambda () (let ready () (unless (file-exists? "callback.release") (usleep 2000) (ready))) (gmk-eval "VALUE := changed") (call-with-output-file "step.tmp" (lambda (p) (display "eval returned\n" p))) (rename-file "step.tmp" "callback.step") (let ready () (unless (file-exists? "callback.resume") (usleep 2000) (ready))) (let ((answer (gmk-expand "$$(VALUE)"))) (call-with-output-file "result.tmp" (lambda (p) (display answer p) (newline p))) (rename-file "result.tmp" "callback.done")))) ""))
$(file >>seen,read-after)
.PHONY: all alpha beta gamma
all: alpha beta
	$(info VALUE=$(VALUE))@:
alpha:
	$(START)$(file >>seen,recipe-init)$(file >transport.auth,$(filter --jobserver-auth=%,$(MAKEFLAGS)))$(fdpressure 64,normal)@/usr/bin/python3 worker.py $@
beta:
	@/usr/bin/python3 worker.py $@
